response.sql: WITH o AS (SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS oa FROM sentimentandfundamentals WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL), g AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS ga FROM sentimentandfundamentals WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY eventannotm) SELECT AVG(g.ga) AS mean_avg_ownership, AVG(g.ga - o.oa) AS mean_excess_over_average FROM g, o WHERE g.ga > o.oa
